annotations.title: utilpeek: cheapest GPU per hour on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Akash, on-demand, spot and marketplace bids, by chip, memory and region

description: utilpeek: GPU prices: cheapest H100, A100, L4 per GPU-hour on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Akash. Returns cheapest GPU prices per GPU-hour on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud (list prices) and Akash (marketplace bids with GPUs free), by chip, memory, minimum GPUs per cloud machine, region and price ceiling; returns USD per machine-hour or null for unknown shape and an unknown-shape exclusion count; optionally rent-or-buy break-even. Input: all optional: `chip`, `min_gpu_mem_gb`, `min_gpus_per_machine`, `provider`, `regions`, `pricing`, `max_usd_per_gpu_hour`, `limit`, `rent_vs_buy`. List prices from a snapshot refreshed twice a day, excluding tax, egress and storage; spot changes often. A snapshot over 36 hours old is a 503 (not charged). Typically under 0.1 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/cloud-gpu-price-api.html

gpus.description: Number of GPUs bought and rented. Defaults to 1, or to the cheapest matching machine's GPU count when min_gpus_per_machine is set; an explicit value overrides that default.
gpus.title: Gpus

hours_per_month.description: Hours per month the GPUs run (utilisation).
hours_per_month.title: Hours Per Month

pue.description: Power usage effectiveness multiplier for cooling and overhead.
pue.title: Pue

purchase_usd.description: Purchase price of the GPUs in USD.
purchase_usd.title: Purchase Usd

resale_pct.description: Resale value after the horizon, percent of the purchase price.
resale_pct.title: Resale Pct

usd_per_kwh.description: Electricity price in USD per kWh.
usd_per_kwh.title: Usd Per Kwh

watts_per_gpu.description: Power draw per GPU in watts under load; defaults by chip when the chip is a known one (H100 700, A100 400, L4 72), else required.
watts_per_gpu.title: Watts Per Gpu

chip.description: GPU chip, any case, e.g. H100 or A100 80GB.
chip.title: Chip

max_usd_per_gpu_hour.description: Ceiling on the ranked price, USD.
max_usd_per_gpu_hour.title: Max Usd Per Gpu Hour

min_gpus_per_machine.description: Minimum GPUs in one cloud machine (1-16). Excludes rows without a known machine shape, including Akash marketplace inventory; count_excluded_unknown_machine_shape reports otherwise-matching rows excluded.
min_gpus_per_machine.title: Min Gpus Per Machine

pricing.description: Price to rank by; any is the lower of the two and also includes Akash marketplace rows (ranked by median bid); on_demand and spot are cloud list prices only.
pricing.title: Pricing

provider.description: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Akash (marketplace bids, with GPUs free).
provider.title: Provider

rent_vs_buy.description: Rent-or-buy break-even against the cheapest matching row: monthly cloud cost, monthly ownership cost, break-even month and totals. When min_gpus_per_machine is set and rent_vs_buy.gpus is omitted, compares all GPUs of that machine; an explicit gpus overrides it. Same price.

name: get_gpu_prices

count_excluded_unknown_machine_shape.description: Otherwise-matching priced rows excluded because min_gpus_per_machine is set and their machine shape is unknown (including Akash inventory). Before limit; zero without the filter. Only rows available from the snapshot and best-effort Akash read are counted.

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.

rent_vs_buy.description: Only with the rent_vs_buy input: break-even against the cheapest matching row; null when no row matches (see rent_vs_buy_unavailable).

break_even_month.description: First month the cumulative cloud cost reaches the purchase plus power so far (resale credited at the horizon); null if never within the horizon

basis.description: instance_share: GPU share of machine price; spot: AWS Linux spot instance / GPUs; marketplace_bid: Akash bid

gpus.description: GPUs per cloud machine when known; Akash rows: total marketplace inventory, not a machine size.

gpus_available.description: Akash rows: GPUs free at read_at

usd_per_machine_hour.description: Selected per-GPU rate times GPUs in the cloud machine, rounded to 4 decimal places (USD per machine-hour). Snapshot per-GPU rates are already rounded to 4 decimals, so this can differ slightly from the provider's instance price due to rounding. Null for unknown machine shape, including Akash inventory.
